comparison.objective: Fill a moka-pot base below its safety valve and screw the top on snug; candidate calibrates switch mounts.
comparison.physical_skill: Liquid dosing, spill avoidance, thread alignment, and bimanual vessel tightening versus partial screw release and fine sensor positioning.
comparison.success_condition: Water must remain below the valve and the pot must finish correctly threaded and snug without spill or cross-threading; candidate needs two sensed endpoints.
comparison.reason: Shared fastening is incidental. The record tests liquid handling and large threaded assembly, not feedback-guided mounted-component calibration.
